driver.offers.pausedDetail: Your rating is below the network minimum, so freight loads are held back. Keep your parcel runs on time — as your rating recovers, freight comes back.
driver.ahead.title: Parcels coming in on this road
driver.ahead.lede: Booked to be handed in, or waiting at the counter. Take them on and the room is held on your vehicle; the shop’s bag for that stop is given to you when it is closed.
driver.ahead.line: {count, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} · {kg} kg for {stop}
driver.ahead.booked: {count, plural, one {# not handed in yet} other {# not handed in yet}}
driver.ahead.takenToast: Taken on: the room is held on your vehicle
driver.ahead.takenToastDetail: The bag for {stop} at {shop} is given to you when it is closed.
driver.ahead.letGoToast: Let go: the room is free again
driver.coming.title: Coming soon on this road
driver.coming.lede: Nothing to claim yet — these are still being filled. You will be offered them when they are ready.
driver.coming.byLine: {kg} of {target} kg · goes by {when} at the latest
driver.offers.emptyLede: No shipments are waiting between those two places right now.
driver.offers.why1: Nothing is waiting near this route
driver.offers.why2: The detour would be too far off your way
driver.offers.why3: Loads bigger than your {kg} kg of space are hidden
driver.offers.title: On your way
driver.offers.earnAbout: You earn about {amount} — the final price locks when you claim
driver.offers.fits: {kg} kg — fits the space you have left
driver.offers.borderMax: The crossing allows at most {kg} kg
driver.offers.borderUnknown: Nobody has recorded this crossing yet — check the permits and insurance you need before you go
driver.home.headingDerivedNote: We worked this out from the load you took. We are showing you work along it.
driver.home.headingDerivedOff: Don’t use my load as my road
driver.home.headingDerivedOn: Use my load as my road again
driver.toast.derivedLegOn: Your next load will set your road
driver.earn.settledLine: {settled} has actually reached you. {inFlight} is on its way.
driver.earn.settledNone: Nothing has been paid out to you yet.
driver.earn.settledFleet: Your earnings are paid to your fleet, not to you directly.
driver.earn.settledNoFleet: You are in no fleet now. What you earned while you drove for a fleet was paid to that fleet, not to you, and the network owes you nothing for it.
driver.earn.settledOwnWork: For work you did on your own, {settled} has reached you and {inFlight} is on its way.
driver.earn.subEmpty: What you have earned on your freight hauls — for whatever you filter to below.
driver.earn.listEmpty: No jobs yet. Claim a freight haul and it lands here.
driver.earn.clawbackLine: {amount} taken back after a claim on this load
driver.paidByShipper: The shipper pays you directly, at the price agreed here. SeeBuyGet pays nothing for this load.
driver.logic.vanFull: Your {vehicle} is full — {loads}. Deliver something to free up space.
driver.logic.freeSpaceBagsOne: Free space out of {kg} kg · room for 1 more bag — {loads}.
driver.logic.freeSpaceBags: Free space out of {kg} kg · room for {bags} more bags — {loads}.
driver.logic.bagsFull: No bag space left — {loads}. You still have weight free, but nowhere to put a bag.
driver.logic.rateMore: You charge {pct}% more than most drivers.
driver.logic.rateLess: You charge {pct}% less than most drivers.
driver.logic.rateSame: You charge about the same as most drivers.
driver.logic.rateDetail: Your rate {mine} per km. Most drivers charge {median} ({min}–{max} across {count, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}}).
driver.logic.statusNotice: Your driver account is {status}. The fleet office must activate you before you can start a shift.
driver.logic.statusNoticeOwn: Your driver account is {status}. Send your ID and your licence below — SeeBuyGet staff check them, and you can start once they have.
driver.logic.shiftSummary: On shift with {plate}. Remaining capacity {kg, plural, one {# kilogram} other {# kilograms}}. {count} claimed loads.
driver.logic.offShiftSummary: Scan the vehicle QR to start your shift.
driver.logic.offersNone: No shipments waiting on this route right now.
driver.logic.offersOne: One shipment on your way. Swipe to see it, then claim it.
driver.logic.offersMany: {count} shipments on your way. Swipe through them, then claim the ones you want.
driver.logic.loadsNone: You have no claimed loads. Find work on your route to pick some up.
driver.logic.loadsOne: {count} claimed load. Remaining capacity {kg, plural, one {# kilogram} other {# kilograms}}.
driver.logic.offerSpokenBase: {message} {kg, plural, one {# kilogram} other {# kilograms}} to {dest}. {detour, plural, one {# kilometre} other {# kilometres}} extra driving.
driver.logic.offerSpokenTime: {base} {collect} extra minutes to collect it, and {deliver} more to drop it.
driver.logic.distanceSplit: of which {empty} km empty to the pickup, {loaded} km loaded
driver.board.title: The freight market
driver.board.lede: Every load out there, including the ones you cannot take yet — and why.
driver.board.emptyLede: Nothing is posted right now. Widen your reach, or look again later.
driver.board.countSplit: {can} you can take · {blocked} you cannot, yet
driver.board.originHere: Looking from where you are now
driver.board.originLede: Deciding whether a run is worth making starts before you make it. Name the place and the whole market is measured from there instead — distances, prices and the order of the list.
driver.board.originLabel: Where do you want to look from?
driver.board.originPh: A town, a depot, a junction
driver.board.originMapLabel: Tap the map to place it by hand
driver.board.originApprox: About {where} — move the pin if it is off
driver.board.originNotFound: We could not place that name. Tap the map instead.
driver.board.originIdle: Type a name and find it, or tap the map.
driver.board.reachNote: This is your reach, not ours — we do not narrow the market for you.
driver.board.perKmNone: No price — couple to a vehicle
driver.board.distance: {empty} km empty to reach it, {loaded} km loaded · {total} km in all
driver.board.bodyGuessed: Wants {body} (guessed from weight — nobody measured it)
driver.board.unlockTitle: What would open up more work
driver.board.unlockLede: Counted only where it is the ONE thing in the way — so this is work you would really win.
driver.board.unlockCount: Would open {loads, plural, one {# more load} other {# more loads}} here, worth about {amount}
driver.board.unlockCountNoPay: Would open {loads, plural, one {# more load} other {# more loads}} here
driver.board.spoken: {total, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}} on the market. {can} you can take, {blocked} you cannot yet.
driver.board.spokenEmpty: Nothing is posted on the market right now.
driver.board.proposeLede: The shipper wants to agree a price before anyone commits. Tell them your number — it holds nothing, and they can still say no.
driver.board.proposeNotePlaceholder: e.g. I am running empty past your gate on Thursday
driver.board.proposeSent: Your price is with the shipper
driver.board.counterTaken: The load is yours at that price
driver.board.awaitingPayment: Accepted: the sender is paying, until {time}
driver.board.counterTakenPaying: You took their price: the sender is paying it
driver.loads.deliveryCodeHint: The sender gave whoever receives it a 6-digit code: ask for it. Without it, the sender can say in their app that it arrived.
driver.board.noLocation: We need a place to measure the market from.
driver.board.noLocationFix: Turn on location and look again — or name the place you want to look from.
driver.board.proposeNeedsPosition: We need your position before you name a price
driver.board.proposeNeedsPositionWhy: Your price is worked out from the empty run to reach the load, so it has to start where you actually are — not where you were looking. Turn on location and try again.
driver.toast.shiftStartedDetail: You are coupled to this vehicle.
driver.toast.restAskedDetail: A notice comes the moment your rest is over.
driver.toast.readingNotKept: The shift has ended — the odometer reading was not kept
driver.toast.defectSentDetail: You are told when they have dealt with it.
driver.toast.defectUnsafe: Your office has been told it is not safe
driver.toast.defectUnsafeDetail: Stop where it is safe and call them. No shift starts in it until it is fixed.
driver.toast.shiftEndQueued: No signal — recorded here, sent when there is one.
driver.toast.rateUpdatedDetail: You now charge the market rate.
driver.toast.pickRoute: Pick where you start and where you are heading.
driver.toast.minEarnSet: You will only be woken for {amount} or more
driver.toast.minEarnCleared: You will be woken for any job near you
driver.toast.snoozedFor: Quiet for {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Your current loads are unchanged.
driver.toast.snoozedOpen: Quiet until you start again. Your current loads are unchanged.
driver.toast.resumedDetail: We will send you loads on your way from now on.
driver.toast.noLocation: We cannot see where you are
driver.toast.noLocationDetail: Allow location for this app, or search along a route instead.
driver.toast.freightPickedUpDetail: Drive it to the destination, then mark it delivered.
driver.toast.freightDeliveredPart: The {n, plural, one {# refused package stays} other {# refused packages stay}} with you: the sender says where they go within 48 hours, and you are told.
driver.toast.attemptRecordedDetail: The sender has been told. The load stays with you until it is delivered.
driver.toast.handedBackDetail: It is back on the market. The sender has been told why.
driver.toast.tempOutOfRangeDetail: Logged — the control tower is alerted.
driver.counter.title: The counter
driver.counter.lede: Nobody publishes what a border post will ask for this month. The people who cross it know, and this is where they say so.
driver.counter.subject: What were you asked for
driver.counter.firstHand: I was there and I was asked for this myself
driver.counter.firstHandWhy: Only your own. What somebody else was asked is theirs to say — otherwise this becomes a rumour with a date on it.
driver.counter.consent: I have blacked out the numbers
driver.counter.noPhoto: We are not allowed to keep photographs of official documents in this country. Say what you were asked for — that part is what everybody needs.
driver.counter.subIdle: Choose a country to see what was asked for
driver.counter.basis: What people were asked for, not what the border requires. A requirement that ended shows here as nobody having been asked since.
driver.road.title: The road
driver.road.lede: What drivers have reported around you. Tap to add what you can see.
driver.road.noneReported: Nothing reported here yet — that is not the same as clear
driver.road.onlyAdvisories: {count} reported, none of them in your way
driver.road.caveat: This map is built by drivers, not surveyed. Check the road yourself.
driver.road.agreeCount: {count, plural, one {# driver agrees} other {# drivers agree}}
driver.road.advisory: Costs you time, not the load
driver.road.disputed: Someone says it is gone — still treat it as there
driver.road.sheetLede: One tap. We take the position from your phone.
driver.road.photoLabel: A photo of it (if you can)
driver.road.photoHint: Only if you can stop safely. Your report warns everybody either way — the picture is what the next driver, and later an operator, actually looks at. Other drivers on this road will see it. Your name never goes with it.
driver.road.photoAlt: A driver’s photo of this road
driver.road.photoTapFull: Tap a photo to open it full size
driver.road.goneWarnTitle: This does not take it off the map
driver.road.goneWarnBody: It stays and keeps warning, and goes to an operator to decide. Being wrong about a bridge that is still standing is what this rule exists to prevent.
driver.road.gonePhotoLabel: A photo of the road (if you can)
driver.road.gonePhotoHint: Other drivers on this road will see it, and so will the operator deciding. Your name never goes with it.
driver.road.heightLabel: Height on the sign, in metres
driver.road.weightLabel: Limit on the sign, in tonnes
driver.road.loadFailed: We could not load what is reported here
driver.toast.roadReportedDetail: Other drivers on this road will see it.
driver.toast.roadQueued: No signal — kept on this phone
driver.toast.roadQueuedDetail: It goes the moment there is a signal, dated now. Other drivers see it once it arrives.
driver.toast.roadAnswerQueuedDetail: Your answer goes the moment there is a signal, dated now.
driver.passage.crosses: Crosses a border: say when it is at the post, and when it has cleared
driver.passage.sayHub: At a hub on the way? Say so
driver.passage.hubPh: Kampala ICD, a depot, a yard
driver.passage.whoIsTold: Its shipper is told, in its app and its own system; so is your fleet’s system, and the page anybody with its tracking link reads. The time and where your phone is are kept with it; nobody is shown where your phone was.
driver.seal.pickupHint: Read each number off the door as it is, and photograph it close up. It is checked here against what the shipper wrote: if it is not the same, the load does not leave.
driver.seal.mismatch: Not the number the shipper wrote. Read it again — if it is the same, the load does not leave: show the shipper.
driver.seal.closeUp: Seal {no} close up, its number readable
driver.seal.readAll: Read every seal off the door and photograph it.
driver.seal.doorTitle: Look at the seals with the receiver: are they as the note says?
driver.seal.doorAsk: Say how the seals were at the door.
driver.seal.resealed: Customs opened it and sealed it again
driver.seal.newCloseUp: The new seal close up, its number readable
driver.seal.officer: The officer’s name or badge, if given
driver.seal.brokenBody: A seal on {ref} is broken. Photograph it as it is, and any paper you were given.
driver.seal.paperPhoto: Any official paper (a police statement, a customs note)
driver.seal.brokenWho: Its shipper is told at once, your fleet’s system, and SeeBuyGet operations. The load is held: it is handed to the receiver once operations releases it. Kept with the consignment note: if anything is missing at delivery, a damage claim report is made from it.
driver.toast.sealReportedDetail: The shipper and SeeBuyGet operations are told. It is handed over once operations releases it; the note keeps it, with your photographs.
driver.tamper.open: Something is not right with this load
driver.tamper.title: Report tampering
driver.tamper.body: What you report holds {ref}: nobody takes it over or receives it until SeeBuyGet operations has looked. Photograph it before anything is touched.
driver.tamper.wrapCut: The wrap or packaging is cut or opened
driver.tamper.inspectionFailed: Found at the 7-point inspection: a false wall, floor or roof, a hidden space, or signs of tampering
driver.inspection.lede: This load crosses a border. Before loading, look over seven points for a false wall, floor or roof, a hidden space, or signs of tampering. Photograph each, and tick it when you found nothing. Found something? Do not tick it: report it below.
driver.inspection.look.front_wall: Knock along it: solid, and as deep inside as it looks outside. No new panels, rivets or welds.
driver.inspection.look.left_side: Inside and out: no unusual repairs, no new rivets or welds, no hollow sound.
driver.inspection.look.right_side: Inside and out: no unusual repairs, no new rivets or welds, no hollow sound.
driver.inspection.look.floor: The same height all along. No loose or new boards, no step up.
driver.inspection.look.roof: No new patches or panels. The height inside as it should be.
driver.inspection.look.doors: Locks, hinges and bolts sound and fixed. Nothing loose, nothing new.
driver.inspection.look.undercarriage: Look underneath: no added boxes or tanks, no new welds, the frame as it should be.
driver.inspection.doAll: Do all seven points of the inspection: each photographed and ticked.
driver.tamper.atDoor: I am at the receiver’s door
driver.tamper.notAsWritten: Still not the same? Report it
driver.tamper.notAsWrittenTitle: Seal {no} is not the one written
driver.tamper.numberRead: The number on the door, as you read it
driver.tamper.doorTitle: The seals are not as the note says
driver.tamper.doorFirst: Report it first, with a photograph: SeeBuyGet operations is told before the receiver takes the goods.
driver.tamper.doorReported: Reported: once operations releases the load, hand it over with the seals as they are.
driver.tamper.who: Its shipper and SeeBuyGet operations are told at once. The note keeps it, with your photograph — never your name.
driver.tamper.heldHint: Held: wait for SeeBuyGet operations to release it.
driver.invoice.title: Commercial invoice — for the border
driver.loads.redirected: {from} is down: take this bag to {to} instead.
driver.loads.redirectedPaid: The extra leg is paid, as the network’s cost.
driver.loads.wholeBag: A whole bag for {final}: hand it to the hub it is addressed to, closed — it is passed on from there.
driver.loads.redirectedKm: The extra {km} km are paid, as the network’s cost.
driver.held.title: Held on the road
driver.held.body: Say who holds {ref}: SeeBuyGet operations, the shipper and your fleet’s office are told at once. Say it again when you are let go.
driver.held.who: Told to SeeBuyGet operations, the shipper and your fleet’s office — never where your phone is. The tracking page says only that it is held on the way.
driver.held.told: Operations, the shipper and your office have been told.
driver.idPhoto.title: Send a photo of your ID
driver.cover.title: Your insurance cover
driver.cover.off: Some senders only give their loads to a carrier with insurance cover. Send your policy: once SeeBuyGet has read it, those loads are open to you, and your consignment notes name your cover.
driver.cover.on: Cover checked by SeeBuyGet, up to {limit} a load, until {until}: loads whose sender asks for cover are open to you.
driver.cover.sheetBody: A clear photo of the page that names the insurer, the policy number, what it covers and until when. SeeBuyGet reads it; nothing changes until then.
driver.cover.sentBody: SeeBuyGet reads it and records your cover (you read it as running until {expires}).
driver.cover.rowRefused: Not accepted — open to see why
driver.carrierPlace.title: Where you work from
driver.carrierPlace.body: Riding for yourself, you are the carrier on your consignment notes, and a carrier is named with its address. Give your business address if you have one; otherwise pin the station you work from.
